organization.name_ja: 国土交通省 近畿地方整備局 淀川河川事務所
organization.name_en: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (Yodogawa River Office)

affected.note: About 34,000 records of users of the Yodoiko! booking site for Yodogawa River Park were on the test server. Email addresses and bank accounts were encrypted.

summary.en: Unauthorized outbound communication was found on a test server for Yodoiko!, the facility booking site of Yodogawa River Park, after user data had been loaded onto it during a system upgrade by a contractor. About 34,000 records including names, addresses, phone numbers, login IDs and passwords may have leaked.
summary.ja: 淀川河川公園の施設予約サイト「よどいこ！」で、委託先の改修作業中に利用者情報を実装したテストサーバから不正な外部通信が確認された。氏名、住所、電話番号、ログインID、パスワードなど約3万4,000件の個人情報が流出した可能性がある。

sources.title: 淀川河川公園施設予約サイトのテストサーバで不正通信 - 個人情報流出か
